intent.description: 将电子书通过 Wi-Fi 无线发送到已越狱并已配对的 Kindle，兼容 KOReader 与 Kindle 原生接收端。用户说“下载《书名》并发到 Kindle”“把这本 EPUB 传到 Kindle”“Send this ebook to Kindle”或点名 qiaomu-send2kindle 时使用。需要找书或下载时先调用乔木电子书 MCP，再核对图书并传送。仅找书、仅下载、解释 Kindle、越狱、刷固件和邮件 Send to Kindle 不属于此 skill。
intent.job_to_be_done: Find the requested ebook, inspect its identity and deliver it over Wi-Fi with a verified receipt.
target_users: Owners of paired jailbroken Kindle devices, with or without Obsidian
inputs: Book title and optional author, language or edition
Or an explicit local ebook path
Physically paired device and unlocked OS credential storage
outputs: Verified Kindle documents path, byte count and SHA256
Original source digest and explicit native scan state
Actionable failure without a false success claim
exclusions: Silent key export or passwordless login
Only finding or downloading without device delivery

should_trigger: 下载《道德经》并发到 Kindle
把这本 EPUB 传到 Kindle
用 qiaomu-send2kindle 给 Kindle 传书
should_not_trigger: 下载这本书，不要发送到 Kindle
near_neighbor: 只解释 Kindle 怎么用
我的 Kindle 不能开机

permissions.network: explicit ebook MCP download, paired private-LAN Kindle, and checksum-pinned receiver preparation
permissions.file_write: requested downloads, machine device metadata/runtime, explicitly selected USB public pairing/settings
permissions.subprocess: isolated Python dependencies and fixed bundled Node converter; no shell interpolation
permissions.secrets: native OS credential backend only; in-memory auth; no vault, argv, log, file export or plaintext fallback

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
